scene.label: Act 2, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. A Room in the Palace

lines.text: Can it be possible that no man saw them?
lines.plainText: Can it be possible that no man saw them

lines.text: It cannot be! Some villains of my court
lines.plainText: It cannot be Some villains of my court

lines.text: Are of consent and sufferance in this.
lines.plainText: Are of consent and sufferance in this

lines.text: I cannot hear of any that did see her.
lines.plainText: I cannot hear of any that did see her

lines.text: The ladies, her attendants of her chamber,
lines.plainText: The ladies her attendants of her chamber

lines.text: Saw her abed, and in the morning early
lines.plainText: Saw her abed and in the morning early

lines.text: They found the bed untreasured of their mistress.
lines.plainText: They found the bed untreasured of their mistress

lines.text: My lord, the roynish clown, at whom so oft
lines.plainText: My lord the roynish clown at whom so oft

lines.text: Your grace was wont to laugh, is also missing.
lines.plainText: Your grace was wont to laugh is also missing

lines.text: Hesperia, the princess' gentlewoman,
lines.plainText: Hesperia the princess' gentlewoman

lines.text: Confesses that she secretly o'erheard
lines.plainText: Confesses that she secretly o'erheard

lines.text: Your daughter and her cousin much commend
lines.plainText: Your daughter and her cousin much commend

lines.text: The parts and graces of the wrestler
lines.plainText: The parts and graces of the wrestler

lines.text: That did but lately foil the sinewy Charles;
lines.plainText: That did but lately foil the sinewy Charles

lines.text: And she believes wherever they are gone
lines.plainText: And she believes wherever they are gone

lines.text: That youth is surely in their company.
lines.plainText: That youth is surely in their company

lines.text: Send to his brother; fetch that gallant hither.
lines.plainText: Send to his brother fetch that gallant hither

lines.text: If he be absent, bring his brother to me.
lines.plainText: If he be absent bring his brother to me

lines.text: I'll make him find him. Do this suddenly!
lines.plainText: I'll make him find him Do this suddenly

lines.text: And let not search and inquisition quail
lines.plainText: And let not search and inquisition quail

lines.text: To bring again these foolish runaways.
